limits: Acceptance on the delivered artifact is six read-only checks. The 255 unit tests and 77 stubbed e2e tests ran against the source revision, not against the installed artifact.

'a rendered reconciliation badge, when the data has one' is conditional on live repository state and passed vacuously: the repository had no conflicting-state issue. The served-stylesheet check covers that badge, and this is recorded rather than counted as evidence.

The minor/minor judgement is the agent's, under the amended policy. main's package.json was still 0.3.2 and it adds addressable views and a theme switcher, which read as capability rather than repair.
